record.one_liner: AI-powered customer support helpdesk (ticketing, inbox, AI Agent) for ecommerce brands
record.auth_notes: REST API: HTTP Basic with the account email as username and a REST API key (created in helpdesk settings) as password, so it is classed as api_key. Official MCP endpoint uses OAuth. critic: confirmed.
record.access_notes: Pricing page offers a free trial with no credit card; plans start at $40/mo and no permanent free tier is listed. REST API is available on all Helpdesk plans; owner/admins create API keys. critic: confirmed self_serve_trial.
record.api_notes: Documented REST API at a per-account base URL (https://{your-domain}.gorgias.com/api/). Rate limit 2 req/s on Starter-Advanced plans, 4 req/s on Enterprise. Breadth not fully reviewed.
record.blocker_notes: Trial path exists for REST API keys. Official MCP is in open beta for paid plan customers, so production use after the trial needs a paid plan. critic: confirmed ready.

evidence.quote: To authenticate API requests, Gorgias uses HTTP Basic Authentication with three pieces of information: your base API URL, your email address, and an API key.
